bugs.desc: CLI reset-path message treats chapters.idx as ordinal: src/presentation/handlers/switch_source.rs prints 「進度重置到第 {new_progress_idx + 1} 章: {name}」. idx is NOT dense (CLAUDE.md czbooks example: first real chapter at idx=1). Probe confirmed: new TOC [idx1 第1章 起風, idx2 第2章] → CLI prints 「進度重置到第 2 章: 第1章 起風」 — wrong user-visible chapter number, contradicting the chapter's own name in the same line. The inline comment even asserts the false premise (「new_progress_idx 是 0-based…以 1-based」). Migrated-path messages are safe (they label the raw value as idx / use chapter name only). DB writes are correct; message-only bug.

All B6 user-facing strings (CLI println! in switch_source.rs, TUI toast in tui/switch_source.rs) have zero test coverage — a regression in migrated-vs-reset wording or the idx+1 fix would survive the suite. Test gap rather than behavior bug, but it is exactly where the med bug lives.

switch_source_core.rs step 4.5 silently swallows DB errors from get_progress/list_old_chapters (.ok().flatten()) and degrades to reset. Deliberate and commented (best-effort per spec), spec doesn't cover DB-error case, but the user gets 「進度重置」 with no hint that a read error occurred.
